decisions.reason: A reusable harvesting crate builds directly on the firm's core crate expertise and its agricultural customer base, so in-house engineering can interpret early results and refine the product.
Foldable large containers are central to the firm's returnable packaging know-how and have their own web page, so the firm can readily learn from the market and improve them.
A stackable plastic crate is a core product category where the firm's existing knowledge and in-house development are strongest.
A medium-duty rackable pallet extends the firm's established pallet engineering, so it builds on related knowledge.
A spill-retention pallet moves toward hazardous-materials handling, somewhat further from the core, but it still rests on pallet design knowledge and is prominently presented.
A pallet with load retainers is a close variant of existing pallet and accessory lines that the firm's engineering can assimilate easily.
